'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**[[Indian Armed Forces]] kill three suspected [[Islamic extremism|terrorists]] during a gunfight in [[Shopian]]. Another security operation is carried out several hours later at an apple orchard, resulting in the deaths of two more terrorists. The raids came a day after five Indian soldiers were killed by suspected terrorists. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/12/india-troops-kill-five-rebels-kashmir-encounters (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Korean wave]]
**American [[Over-the-top media service|streaming service]] [[Netflix]], the world's largest entertainment company by [[market capitalization]], confirms that the [[Television in South Korea|South Korean television]] series ''[[Squid Game]]'' is its most-watched program worldwide, having been viewed by more than 111 million accounts since its release in September. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/entertainment/10/13/21/squid-game-becomes-netflixs-biggest-ever-launch-hit (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economy of France]]
**[[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] announces a [[Euro|€]]30 billion plan to [[Reindustrialization|re-industrialize]] [[France]], in order to address what he called "a kind of growth deficit" and make France reclaim its title as a "global leader in innovation and research". [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/macron-announces-30-billion-euro-plan-re-industrialise-france-2238671 (CNA)] 
*[[Economy of Ukraine]]
**The [[European Union]] vows to help [[Ukraine]] with its gas supplies as [[Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelensky]] underlines his concerns of potential [[government of Russia|Russian]] political leverage in the region in the aftermath of the agreement with [[Germany]] regarding the [[Nord Stream]] pipeline. [https://www.dw.com/en/eu-chief-vows-to-help-ukraine-with-gas-supply/a-59478866 (Deutsche Welle)]
*The [[European Commission]] raises a [[climate bond]] worth {{€|12 billion}} ([[United States dollar|US$]]13.9 billion) as part of its [[European Green Deal]], the largest climate bond issued in the global [[capital market]]. [https://timesofmalta.com/articles/view/eu-holds-worlds-largest-green-bond-sale.907516 (AFP via ''Times of Malta'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Pacific typhoon season]]
**At least nine people are killed in the [[Philippines]] during [[flood]]s and [[landslide]]s caused by [[Tropical Storm Kompasu (2021)|Tropical Storm Kompasu]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/cyclone-kompasu-strikes-philippines-kills-9-2021-10-12/ (Reuters)]
*At least 25 people are killed and several others are injured in a bus crash in [[Mugu District]], [[Nepal]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-58878735 (BBC News)]
*A train kills three people and injures a fourth, all of whom were lying on the tracks in [[Saint-Jean-de-Luz]], [[Nouvelle-Aquitaine]], [[France]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/france-regional-train-strikes-four-people-killing-three/a-59476996 (Deutsche Welle)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Romania]]
****[[Romania]] reports a record 16,443 new cases and 442 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|deaths]] from [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,382,531 and the nationwide death toll to 40,071. [https://www.romania-insider.com/index.php/covid-cases-ro-oct-12-2021 (''Romania Insider'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record 973 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 218,345. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/russia-registers-record-daily-covid-19-deaths-80532312 (ABC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in San Marino]]
***The need to show an [[immunity passport]] for access to indoor premises where it is not possible to guarantee an interpersonal space, as well as for access to events, including sporting events, shows, entertainment events, parties and events where dancing takes place and for practicing contact sports, comes into force. [https://www.sanmarinortv.sm/news/attualita-c4/pubblicato-il-nuovo-decreto-restrizioni-per-locali-e-discipline-sportive-a214539 (San Marino RTV)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in India]]
***[[India]]n [[Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation|drug regulator]] approves the emergency use of the [[Bharat Biotech]] [[Covaxin]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] for children aged between 2 to 18. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/bharat-biotech-s-covaxin-approved-for-emergency-use-in-children-101634029754231.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Panama]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Panama]]
***[[Panama]] approves the usage of the [[Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] as booster for high-risk people, including healthcare workers, bedridden residents, nursing home residents, and people aged over 55. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/panama-approves-pfizer-covid-19-booster-high-risk-people-2021-10-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Iqaluit]], capital city of Canada's [[Nunavut]] territory, is placed under a Do Not Drink Water advisory until further notice due to the possibility of contamination by petroleum hydrocarbons. Both boiled and filtered water are not safe for consumption at this time. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/canada/don-t-drink-the-water-iqaluit-drinking-water-supply-possibly-tainted-with-petroleum-hydrocarbons-1.5620475 (CTV News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of Afghanistan]]
**[[German Chancellor]] [[Angela Merkel]] says that [[Germany]] "is not yet prepared to recognize the [[Taliban]] government" since they have not met demands of inclusiveness. However, Merkel reassures the promise of Germany's 600 million euro aid to the country. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/germany-not-yet-prepared-recognise-taliban-merkel-2021-10-12/ (Reuters)]
*The [[International Court of Justice]] rules in favor of [[Somalia]] in its dispute with [[Kenya]] over a maritime border rich in gas and oil. Kenya labels the case as "biased" and says that it does not recognize the ruling. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-58885535 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[LGBT rights in Botswana]]
**A panel of judges in [[Botswana]] postpone a ruling on a case brought by the [[government of Botswana|government]] to overturn the 2019 decriminalization of [[homosexuality]] in the country. Prior to being decriminalized, [[gay sex]] was punishable by up to seven years' imprisonment. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/botswana-appeals-ruling-allowing-gay-sex-court-delays-judgment-2021-10-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[2021 Cuban protests]]
**The [[Government of Cuba|Cuban government]] rejects a request from the [[Cuban dissident movement|opposition]] to hold a protest in [[Havana]] on November 15, claiming involvement of the [[United States government]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20211012-cuban-government-bans-bid-for-new-protests (AFP via France 24)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**[[NASA]] astronomers announce the discovery of [[TIC 257060897b]], a [[Hot Jupiter]] [[exoplanet]] that is 50% larger and 30% less massive than [[Jupiter]]. The discovery was made using the [[Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite]]. [https://www.sciencetimes.com/articles/33900/20211012/nasa-discovered-new-inflated-low-density-hot-jupiter-exoplanet-50.htm (''Science Times'')]
